description: Jensen Das Ugly Stik (Phil Kraft design), 60 in span, .61 two-stroke glow. Physics data only; visual geometry lives in assets/aircraft/ugly-stik-60/geometry.json.

crash_hull.source: Points that hit the ground first (le frame): wing tips (60 in span, slight dihedral), spinner tip (firewall 6.94 in ahead of LE plus engine and spinner), tail end and stabilizer tips (52 in overall length), fin top, main and nose wheel bottoms (wheels from the visual model's equipment table: axle 0.215 m below the thrust line, 0.038 m wheel radius, 0.36 m track). Read from the Jensen plan and the visual model; replaced by measured gear contact points in E1

mass_range.source: Stick-family .60 manuals: Ultra Stick .60 6-7 lb, Big Stik .60 6.5 lb (RESEARCH.md), widened

inertia_reference.source: UltraStick25e Jxx Jyy Jzz (1.959 kg, 1.27 m span); compared after scaling by m·b²

aileron.source: Not on the Jensen plan or in its notes; typical low-rate sport throw used since Stage 1 (formerly app/spec.gd CONTROLS). Open research track: control throws (ROADMAP)

elevator.source: Not on the Jensen plan or in its notes; typical low-rate sport throw used since Stage 1 (formerly app/spec.gd CONTROLS). Open research track: control throws (ROADMAP)

rudder.source: Not on the Jensen plan or in its notes; typical low-rate sport throw used since Stage 1 (formerly app/spec.gd CONTROLS). Open research track: control throws (ROADMAP)

servo_full_throw_time.source: Time for a surface to go from neutral to full throw: a standard analog servo at 0.19 s/60 deg (Hitec HS-311 / Futaba S3003 class at 6 V) times about 45 deg of servo-arm travel for full surface throw (typical linkage). Same for every surface

aero.source: OpenFlightSim UltraStick25e AeroOpenFlight.xml @ b020511 (sha256 43ff5c1e…); nondimensional, applied to the Ugly Stik as a geometrically similar Stik

CL_max.source: Whole-airplane maximum lift: mid value of the CLmax 1.0-1.2 assumed in the ROADMAP predicted-handling table (semi-symmetric Jensen section, Re about 3e5); gives a 1-g stall near 9.0 m/s

CL_min.source: Negative stall of a semi-symmetric section is weaker than the positive one; assumed about 0.7 x CL_max

stall_blend_width.source: Width of the smooth transition from attached flow to flat-plate flow (PicaSim uses a cosine ramp of about 10 deg, YASim a stall-width parameter); the start is solved so the lift peak equals CL_max

CD90.source: Flat-plate drag of the finite wing at 90 deg: Viterna CDmax = 1.11 + 0.018 AR with AR = b^2/S = 5.0 (NASA CR-1983, RESEARCH.md plan review #3)

sideslip_blend.source: Sideslip range where the linear beta terms (CYb, Clb, Cnb) give way to their sin(beta) form, finite and restoring up to knife edge

conventions.rates: p_hat = p·b/(2V), q_hat = q·c/(2V), r_hat = r·b/(2V)
conventions.elevator: per radian, positive = trailing edge DOWN (dCm/dElev < 0)
conventions.aileron: per radian per surface, positive = trailing edge DOWN; right and left listed separately
conventions.rudder: per radian, positive = trailing edge LEFT (dCn/dRud < 0)
conventions.axes: lift, drag, side force in wind axes; roll, pitch, yaw moments in body axes about the aero reference point

CYdr.source: docs/research/flight-repair-implementation.md: provisional surface model; estimated, not measured flight data; CYdr=a_v*S_v/S*tau; Cndr=-CYdr*l/b; Cldr=CYdr*(z_v-z_ARP)/b; Cnb=a_v*S_v/S*l/b

propulsion.description: D5 thrust v0: engine rpm follows throttle with a first-order lag; thrust and torque from propeller coefficients at the current advance ratio. In-flight prop unloading (rpm rising with airspeed) waits for the shaft model (G2).

max_rpm_static.source: power balance: engine power assumed linear in rpm below the peak (estimated) = static prop power Cp·ρ·n³·D⁵ with Cp 0.0471 → n = sqrt(P_peak/n_peak / (Cp·ρ·D⁵))

lag_time_constant.source: first-order throttle response of a glow engine; replace with a throttle-step measurement

propeller.name: APC 12x6 Sport (LP12060)
propeller.rotation: clockwise seen from behind (standard tractor): the reaction torque rolls the airplane left

ct_table.source: UIUC propeller database vol. 1, measured APC Sport 11x6: apcsp_11x6_static_rd0488.txt (sha256 911866f1…) and apcsp_11x6_rd0495_6000.txt (sha256 987b1268…); applied to the 12x6 Sport by T = Ct·ρ·n²·D⁴ (APC's own 12x6 file is not reachable here); J = 0 row from the static run at 5,954 rpm, linear between J = 0 and 0.373 (no measurements there)

cp_table.source: UIUC propeller database vol. 1, measured APC Sport 11x6: apcsp_11x6_static_rd0488.txt (sha256 911866f1…) and apcsp_11x6_rd0495_6000.txt (sha256 987b1268…); applied to the 12x6 Sport by T = Ct·ρ·n²·D⁴ (APC's own 12x6 file is not reachable here)

rotating_inertia.source: Propeller + spinner + crankshaft about the shaft, for gyroscopic precession: APC Sport 12x6 about 37 g as a rod (m L^2 / 12 = 2.9e-4) plus spinner, nut and crankshaft (about 0.6e-4). Turns clockwise seen from behind (+x)

thrust_line_offset.source: thrust line through the CG height (plan: thrust line close to the fuselage centre); [x_aft, y_right, z_up] from the CG
